pre_wbcp_archive_scope: Local tag archiving the pre-WBCP stack: max(finite-rank conformal radius, Bayesian bootstrap quantile) without a test atom, optional fitting importance weights with an ESS gate, a fixed training-reference subset and quantile groups, and the bca-noiw tooling that reads its checkpoints.

scientific_design.iql: One host actor and one BCA actor share Q/V, native beta and gain 1; one Bayesian bootstrap scale fitter (variant wbcp_uniform) with no importance factors; the BCA actor consumes the frozen WBCP threshold through post-cap AWR shrinkage.
scientific_design.baseline: Same reserved training complement and host configuration; not a published full-data reproduction.
scientific_design.radius: Weighted Bayesian conformal prediction (Lou and Luo, arXiv:2604.06464v3, Algorithm 1) with uniform weights and test mass 1 (BQ-CP): alpha 0.1, credibility 0.95, draws 1000. Unweighted held-out scores |y - q| / (max(eta, 1e-6) u) plus one test atom at the worst-case loss; threshold = max(lambda_hat, lambda_HPD), +inf when nothing is certifiable. Consumed width = threshold x frozen scale x frozen unit.
scientific_design.held_out_bank_gate: BCA preparation requires calibration.reference.certifiable(n): at most 1e-6 probability that the test atom prevents a finite threshold (n >= 36 at the declared settings).
scientific_design.calibration_bank: Thinned reservation (calibration/bank.py): ceil(target/K) withheld episodes chosen with probability proportional to length, one row from each of K equal segments as the WBCP bank; every row of a withheld episode leaves training and the cap counts them all. K = rows_per_episode per dataset: the smallest K >= 5 that fits the cap (experiments/wbcp/choose_rows_per_episode.py); banks outside K <= 10 with >= 100 episodes carry dependence_validated=false. Whole-episode banks fail about 28% (experiments/wbcp/DEPENDENCE.md).

validation.scope: CPU only, synthetic transitions and stub environments; no full training run and no simulator step (experiments/wbcp/README.md). This manifest lists the suites; it does not record their pass/fail status.

suites.experiments/wbcp/test_wbcp.py: 15 exact-identity checks of calibration/wbcp.py (Dirichlet/Beta laws, Eq. 1 ties, Eq. 7 order statistic, clamp, weight scale/order invariance); NumPy and SciPy only.
suites.experiments/wbcp/test_bank.py: 6 checks of calibration/bank.py: distinct episodes, one row per segment, inclusion probability exactly proportional to length, equal per-row calibration probability, determinism, rejected requests; NumPy and SciPy only.
suites.experiments/wbcp/test_reference.py: 14 checks of freeze_reference, initial_reference, frozen_level_dose, reference_valid, WBCPConfig, the certifiable bank gate and reserve_calibration (partition, thinning, cap, determinism, population-split mode).
suites.experiments/wbcp/test_td3_bc_host.py: 12 checks: typed configs, native multiplier before the first refresh, certified refresh and its folded key, consumption of the frozen reference, invalid-refresh handling, host arm without calibration state, checkpoint round trip, runtime refresh journal, thinned reservation and its re-verification.
suites.experiments/wbcp/test_rebrac_host.py: 12 checks with the same scope as the TD3+BC suite.
suites.experiments/wbcp/test_cql_host.py: 6 checks: typed configs and rows per episode, rejection of archived inputs and mismatched schedules, native behavior until refresh then frozen-threshold consumption, invalid-refresh abort, host arm without calibration state, prepare/run refresh journal with the thinned reservation.
suites.experiments/wbcp/test_iql_host.py: 12 checks: typed configs, native weights before refresh, refresh, consumption, uncertifiable-threshold fallback, pair runtime counters, small-bank rejection, checkpoint decoding, host arm without calibration state, rows-per-episode validation, thinned prepare_dataset, partition evidence.
suites.experiments/test_wbcp_configs.py: 4 known-answer checks: every config resolves to wbcp_uniform / bca-wbcp, every dataset passes its rows_per_episode to its host, a dataset without it is refused, and the archived calibration_weighting switch is refused.
suites.experiments/wbcp/reproduce_table1.py: Reproduction script for Table 1 of Lou and Luo (section 4.1); its reported numbers are in experiments/wbcp/README.md.
